description: DDT 70 - Classement sonore des routes nationales et routes départementales en Haute-Saône is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by haute-saone.gouv.fr. Classification, in one of the five categories, of the width of the sectors affected by noise for each section of the national roads and departmental roads in Haute-Saône following Decree DDT 70 No 340 and No 341 of 10 July 2015. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DDT 70 — Sound rating of national and departmental roads in Haute-Saône" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include bruit, nuisance, haute-saône, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2017-02-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
